currentRoundInspection.scope: Three actually inspected prayer-hall/Phoenix/tower pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys or redistributed images.

pictures.author: Nat Krause
pictures.license: Public-domain dedication by photographer;building rights separate
pictures.observed: Actually inspected1024×768 prayer-hall view:green-blue glazed curved tiled roof with raised ridge/corner ends,deep projecting eaves and bracket rhythm,weathered red timber columns,open shallow portico,closed wooden screen/door bays,low rails and raised stone steps. Fine calligraphy and painted floral/bracket artwork are not copied.

pictures.author: Larry Koester
pictures.observed: Actually inspected960×640 Phoenix Pavilion:central tall hexagonal curved pyramidal roof with finial,lower side pavilions and short roofed connecting arms,red columns,open passages,wood beam/plaque/lattice bands and low pale stone garden rails. Existing grey barrel-tile surface and broad timber/bracket/finial geometry approximate details;plaques remain blank.

pictures.observed: Actually inspected500×667 tower view:three levels of broad upturned green eaves around an octagonal dark timber tower,brick ground core with open arched passage,outer columns,upper dark screen fields and balcony railing,small finial.
